purpose: Reproducible study priorities; no validated prediction of a future exam.
vocabularyFit: Exam and review prompts only; generated questions and key answers excluded.

method.patternWeight: .75 * exam pattern proportion + .25 * review pattern proportion
method.score: 1 + .6 * normalized pattern weight + .25 * maximum exam cosine similarity + .15 * maximum review cosine similarity
method.coefficients: Editorial study weights, not fitted or validated performance estimates.
method.similarity: L2-normalized sublinear TF–IDF; vocabulary and IDF fitted to 45 source prompts only.
method.selection: Lecture and format quotas first; weighted sampling without replacement within each group.
